title: Pioneer Homestead
details: 📅 Q3 · Unit 7 · Territorial Florida and the Seminole Story

badge.name: Field Seal 18
badge.line: Only field historians earn this one. You went where your teacher can't go, and you brought back proof.

hook.look: A field file is a job card. It tells a historian where to go and what to bring back.
hook.head: Field File 18 · Pioneer Homestead
rows: A pioneer homestead in territorial Florida
Your teacher, still stuck inside Canvas
hook.alt: A small hut with a roof and walls made of palm leaves, with palm trees around it
hook.cap: A pioneer home in South Florida, 1891. Photo by George Barker. Library of Congress.
hook.note: There are no photos of Florida's first pioneers. Cameras came later. Can you build a pioneer homestead so I can see one?

opti.brief: She can't leave Canvas, so you build it. Make a pioneer homestead in a forest. Then send her one photo.
opti.desk: No headset? Use my desk. Play the game, then write 2 sentences for your teacher.

vr.look: A pioneer was one of the first settlers in a new place. A homestead is a family's home and farm.

steps.title: Get ready
steps.html:
These are the models you will use. In VR, type the gray word in the Models search box to find each one.

@MODELS@

In VR, this page is on the Canvas tab.

steps.title: Go in
steps.html:
🔗 First time only: connect Canvas at xr.optimaed.com. See Having trouble in VR? below.

Open the On-Demand app. Click Explore. Type Tranquil in Filter environments. Click Tranquil Forest, then Begin Solo.

steps.title: Build the homestead
steps.html: Put the 4 log walls in a square, with the door in one wall. Plant the corn and the potatoes on one side of the cabin. Put the pig and the barrel on the other side.

steps.title: Take your photo and send it
steps.html:
Open your menu, click Library, then Camera. Fit your whole build in the tablet. Click Take photo.

On the Canvas tab, pick @CANVAS@. Click Choose from My Files, pick your photo, click Use this file, then Submit to Canvas. Look for the green Submitted tag.

🔁 To fix it, send a new photo.

steps.title: Check and leave
steps.html: Press the Meta button, then click Quit. Check that your photo is in the Canvas assignment. Not there? See Having trouble in VR?

extra.html: Build at the edge of the trees. Pioneers cleared their land by hand, one tree at a time.

vr.full: One photo that shows the cabin, the crops, the pig and the barrel.

studio.title: Work or Hardship?
studio.look: Each card is one part of pioneer life from our lesson. Some cards are daily work. Some are hardships, things that made life hard.
studio.do: Tap a card, then tap its box.

labels.step: Tap a card, then tap its box.

game.miss: Not that box. Is this a job someone did, or something that made life hard?
game.done: The tray is empty! Pioneer life was hard work, every single day.

cards.name: Hauling water
cards.ok: Yes! Children hauled water every day.

cards.name: Mosquitoes
cards.what: They carried malaria and yellow fever
cards.ok: Yes. Mosquitoes made people very sick.

cards.name: Growing corn and sweet potatoes
cards.ok: Yes! Families grew their own food.

cards.name: No doctor nearby
cards.what: The nearest one could be a day's ride away
cards.ok: Yes. Help was hard to find.

cards.name: Gathering firewood
cards.ok: Yes! Everyone in the family worked.

cards.name: Hurricanes and floods
cards.ok: Yes. Storms could wreck a farm.

cards.name: Neighbors miles away
cards.ok: Yes. Being cut off from people was hard.

frames.starter: One hard thing about pioneer life was ...
The land pioneers settled was already home to ...

studio.full: Your game is done, and your 2 sentences have 20 words or more.
